jp: さぁて、神の間にはどんな秘密が隠されてるのかなー？ふふふ、秘密を暴くのって楽しいもんね！
jp_grezzo: "さぁて、神の間にはどんな秘密が隠されてるのかなー？ふふふ、秘密を暴くのって楽しいもんね！"
en: Well then, what sorts of secrets could possibly be sealed away in the Eternal Seal? Fufufu, it sure is fun to uncover the truth behind some secrets, now isn't it!
en_grezzo: "Well then, what sorts of secrets could possibly be sealed away in the Eternal Seal? Fufufu, it sure is fun to uncover the truth behind some secrets, now isn't it!"
it: Beeene, e nel Sigillo Eterno che segreti ci saranno nascosti? Ehehe, che bello scoperchiare i segreti, vero!

jp: へぇー。ロスリアの連中になかなか出くわさないと思ったら、本隊はまだ上の階層にいるんだ。やっぱり少数精鋭が身軽だよね！あまりに大所帯だと思うように進めないんじゃないかなぁ。
jp_grezzo: "へぇー。ロスリアの連中になかなか出くわさないと思ったら、本隊はまだ上の階層にいるんだ。やっぱり少数精鋭が身軽だよね！あまりに大所帯だと思うように進めないんじゃないかなぁ。"
en: Well, well. Just as I thought I'd barely seen any Lothrians around these parts, it turns out that their main army is still in the upper levels. It sure is easier to send down only a small group of highly trained elites. I guess we won't be able to advance as far as we want if we're too large of a group.
en_grezzo: "Well, well. Just as I thought I'd barely seen any Lothrians around these parts, it turns out that their main army is still in the upper levels. It sure is easier to send down only a small group of highly trained elites. I guess we won't be able to advance as far as we want if we're too large of a group."
it: Toh. Mi chiedevo perché di quelli di Lothria non se ne incontrasse quasi nessuno: il grosso della squadra è ancora ai piani di sopra. Eh, pochi e buoni si va più leggeri! Con troppa gente appresso non si avanza come si vorrebbe, no?

jp: 問題数ももっと増やさなきゃなぁ…。あ、次回のクイズは次の1日と15日にやるからね。本職のほうは明日からやるよ。
jp_grezzo: "問題数ももっと増やさなきゃなぁ…。あ、次回のクイズは次の1日と15日にやるからね。本職のほうは明日からやるよ。"
en: I'll have to increase the number of questions... Oh, the next quiz will be on the 1st and 15th of next month. My real job begins tomorrow.
en_grezzo: "I'll have to increase the number of questions... Oh, the next quiz will be on the 1st and 15th of next month. My real job begins tomorrow."
it: Devo aumentare il numero di domande... Ah, il prossimo quiz lo faccio il 1 e il 15 del mese prossimo. Al mestiere vero ci torno da domani.

jp: イエーイ！冒険者4択クイズ～！ルールは簡単、10問連続の4択クイズに素早く正解しようっ！かかった時間と正解数で得点が決まるけど、制限時間は60秒。それを過ぎるといくら正解していても0点になるから気をつけて！ええっとキミなら…ティリス大陸にまつわる問題でいこうか。
jp_grezzo: "イエーイ！冒険者4択クイズ～！ルールは簡単、10問連続の4択クイズに素早く正解しようっ！かかった時間と正解数で得点が決まるけど、制限時間は60秒。それを過ぎるといくら正解していても0点になるから気をつけて！ええっとキミなら…ティリス大陸にまつわる問題でいこうか。"
en: Ya-ay! It's the Adventurer's 4 Choice Quiz~! The rules are simple: Answer a series of ten multiple-choice questions as quickly and correctly as you can! The time taken and the number of correct answers will determine your score. The time limit is 60 seconds, and after that, no matter how many answers you get right, you get zero points, so be careful! Now, for someone like you... let's try some questions related to the continent of Tyris.
en_grezzo: "Ya-ay! It's the Adventurer's 4 Choice Quiz~! The rules are simple: Answer a series of ten multiple-choice questions as quickly and correctly as you can! The time taken and the number of correct answers will determine your score. The time limit is 60 seconds, and after that, no matter how many answers you get right, you get zero points, so be careful! Now, for someone like you... let's try some questions related to the continent of Tyris."
it: Iehiii! È il Quiz dell'avventuriero a quattro risposte! Le regole sono semplici: dieci domande di fila, e devi rispondere giusto e in fretta! Il punteggio viene dal tempo che ci metti e dalle risposte giuste, ma il limite è di 60 secondi: passati quelli fai 0 punti anche se hai azzeccato tutto, quindi occhio! Ehm, per te... facciamo le domande sul continente di Tyris?

jp: やらないよ
jp_grezzo: "やらないよ"
en: Not ready.
en_grezzo: "Not ready."
it: Lascio perdere

jp: ＯＫ！
jp_grezzo: "ＯＫ！"
en: All right!
en_grezzo: "All right!"
it: OK!

jp: それじゃあ準備はいいかな？問題文は下の方に出すからね！
jp_grezzo: "それじゃあ準備はいいかな？問題文は下の方に出すからね！"
en: Okay then, are you ready? I'll put the text of the question at the bottom!
en_grezzo: "Okay then, are you ready? I'll put the text of the question at the bottom!"
it: Allora, tutto pronto? Il testo della domanda te lo metto giù in basso!

jp: なんてこったい。
jp_grezzo: "なんてこったい。"
en: Sorry!
en_grezzo: "Sorry!"
it: Ma dai, che peccato.

it: Via!

it: "Bel lavoro! Tempo impiegato: " + endsec + " secondi, risposte giuste: " + seikai + "."

jp: 最終スコアは点だよ！今までの最高記録は点だから…新記録だね！おめでとう！
jp_grezzo: "最終スコアは" + gdata(GDATA_FLAG_MELGET_SCORE) + "点だよ！今までの最高記録は" + gdata(GDATA_FLAG_MELGET_HISCORE) + "点だから…新記録だね！おめでとう！"

contesto: chatMore lang("最終スコアは" + gdata(GDATA_FLAG_MELGET_SCORE) + "点だよ！今までの最高記録は" + gdata(GDATA_FLAG_MELGET_HISCORE) + "点だから…新記録だね！おめでとう！", "Your score is " + gdata(GDATA_FLAG_MELGET_SCORE) + " points! It's a new record!!")
it: "Il punteggio finale è " + gdata(GDATA_FLAG_MELGET_SCORE) + " punti! Il primato di prima era " + gdata(GDATA_FLAG_MELGET_HISCORE) + " punti, quindi... è un record nuovo! Complimenti!"

jp: 最終スコアは点！…うーん、最高記録である点は更新できなかったか。また挑戦してね～。
jp_grezzo: "最終スコアは" + gdata(GDATA_FLAG_MELGET_SCORE) + "点！…うーん、最高記録である" + gdata(GDATA_FLAG_MELGET_HISCORE) + "点は更新できなかったか。また挑戦してね～。"
en: Your score is  points. Next time, try to beat the record of  points!
en_grezzo: "Your score is " + gdata(GDATA_FLAG_MELGET_SCORE) + " points. Next time, try to beat the record of " + gdata(GDATA_FLAG_MELGET_HISCORE) + " points!"
contesto: chatMore lang("最終スコアは" + gdata(GDATA_FLAG_MELGET_SCORE) + "点！…うーん、最高記録である" + gdata(GDATA_FLAG_MELGET_HISCORE) + "点は更新できなかったか。また挑戦してね～。", "Your score is " + gdata(GDATA_FLAG_MELGET_SCORE) + " points. Next time, try to beat the record of " + gdata(GDATA_FLAG_MELGET_HISCORE) + " points!")
it: "Il punteggio finale è " + gdata(GDATA_FLAG_MELGET_SCORE) + " punti! ...Mah, il primato di " + gdata(GDATA_FLAG_MELGET_HISCORE) + " punti non l'hai battuto. Riprova, eh."

jp: 200点超えたから、一応努力賞出しておくね。一応、ね。
jp_grezzo: "200点超えたから、一応努力賞出しておくね。一応、ね。"
en: Since you scored at least 200 points, I'll give you an Effort Award.
en_grezzo: "Since you scored at least 200 points, I'll give you an Effort Award."
it: Hai superato i 200 punti, quindi un premio di consolazione te lo do. Di consolazione, eh.

jp: さようなら
jp_grezzo: "さようなら"
en: Goodbye.
en_grezzo: "Goodbye."
it: Arrivederci

jp: 他冒険者の所持品(10000gp)
jp_grezzo: "他冒険者の所持品(10000gp)"
en: Tell me of some adventurer's inventory. (10000gp)
en_grezzo: "Tell me of some adventurer's inventory. (10000gp)"
it: Che cos'hanno gli altri avventurieri (10000 oro)

jp: 今月の豆知識(500gp)
jp_grezzo: "今月の豆知識(500gp)"
en: Tell me your monthly knowledge. (500gp)
en_grezzo: "Tell me your monthly knowledge. (500gp)"
it: La curiosità del mese (500 oro)

jp: あー、色々しゃべっちゃいたくてウズウズするなぁ！どうしようかなー。何を教えちゃおうかなー？
jp_grezzo: "あー、色々しゃべっちゃいたくてウズウズするなぁ！どうしようかなー。何を教えちゃおうかなー？"
en: Oh, I want to talk about so many things, I'm so excited! What should I do? What should I teach?
en_grezzo: "Oh, I want to talk about so many things, I'm so excited! What should I do? What should I teach?"
it: Ah, ho un prurito addosso dalla voglia di raccontare un sacco di cose! Che faccio? Che cosa ti insegno?

jp: うーん…全部教えるのもつまらないし、キミ以外の冒険者が現在持っている固定アーティファクトや貴重品を「ひとつまで」教えてあげる。メモの準備はいい？一度しか言わないよ。
jp_grezzo: "うーん…全部教えるのもつまらないし、キミ以外の冒険者が現在持っている固定アーティファクトや貴重品を「ひとつまで」教えてあげる。メモの準備はいい？一度しか言わないよ。"
en: Well, teaching you everything would be boring, rather I'll tell you about fixed artifacts and valuable items that other adventurers have. Ready to take notes? I'll only say it once.
en_grezzo: "Well, teaching you everything would be boring, rather I'll tell you about fixed artifacts and valuable items that other adventurers have. Ready to take notes? I'll only say it once."
it: Mah... dirti tutto sarebbe noioso: degli artefatti unici e degli oggetti preziosi che hanno addosso gli altri avventurieri te ne dico \"al massimo uno\" per ciascuno. Carta e penna? Lo dico una volta sola.

jp: 私、チョコレートとか嫌いだから。だからバレンタインの中止を願ったんだけど、そしたら願いの女神が手作りチョコをよこしてきたの。もったいないから仕方なく食べたけど、願いの女神も色々と大変ね…。
jp_grezzo: "私、チョコレートとか嫌いだから。だからバレンタインの中止を願ったんだけど、そしたら願いの女神が手作りチョコをよこしてきたの。もったいないから仕方なく食べたけど、願いの女神も色々と大変ね…。"
en: I hate things like chocolate. So I wished for Valentine's Day to be discontinued, then the Wish Goddess gave me some handmade chocolate. It would be a waste so I reluctantly ate it but... The Wish Goddess is also very troublesome.
en_grezzo: "I hate things like chocolate. So I wished for Valentine's Day to be discontinued, then the Wish Goddess gave me some handmade chocolate. It would be a waste so I reluctantly ate it but... The Wish Goddess is also very troublesome."
it: A me la cioccolata non piace. Così ho chiesto che San Valentino venisse abolito, e la dea dei desideri mi ha mandato dei cioccolatini fatti a mano. Buttarli era un peccato e me li sono mangiati per forza... Anche lei ne ha di grane...

jp: とあるドラゴンハンターの攻撃は、ドラゴン類に対して１割ほど与えるダメージが多いの。ドラゴンにはドラゴンの攻撃が効果抜群…というわけではなくて、単純に強い殺意で力が入ってるんでしょうね。
jp_grezzo: "とあるドラゴンハンターの攻撃は、ドラゴン類に対して１割ほど与えるダメージが多いの。ドラゴンにはドラゴンの攻撃が効果抜群…というわけではなくて、単純に強い殺意で力が入ってるんでしょうね。"
en: A certain dragon hunter's attack does about 10% more damage against dragons. It's not that dragon attacks are very effective against dragons... it's simply that they're very powerful with a strong intent to kill.
en_grezzo: "A certain dragon hunter's attack does about 10% more damage against dragons. It's not that dragon attacks are very effective against dragons... it's simply that they're very powerful with a strong intent to kill."
it: Gli attacchi di una certa cacciatrice di draghi fanno un 10% di danno in più sui draghi. Non che gli attacchi di drago siano superefficaci sui draghi: è che ci mette dentro tutta la voglia di ammazzarli.

jp: ザナンの実験施設の収容者リストを見ていて気がついたんだけど、全員の名前をつなげて読むと文章になるの。すごい偶然だと思わない？
jp_grezzo: "ザナンの実験施設の収容者リストを見ていて気がついたんだけど、全員の名前をつなげて読むと文章になるの。すごい偶然だと思わない？"
en: When I was looking at the list of inmates at Xanan's experimental facility, I noticed that if you join all the names together, they form a sentence. Isn't that an amazing coincidence?
en_grezzo: "When I was looking at the list of inmates at Xanan's experimental facility, I noticed that if you join all the names together, they form a sentence. Isn't that an amazing coincidence?"
it: Guardando la lista dei reclusi dell'istituto sperimentale di Zanan mi sono accorta di una cosa: se leggi i nomi di tutti uno dietro l'altro, viene fuori una frase. Non ti pare una coincidenza pazzesca?

jp: 中央神殿の神様はどれだけジュア狂なのかしら。目の前で癒しの女神に色々セクハラしようとしたけど、絶対に防衛されちゃうの。壁の向こうからでも察知して阻止するのよ？神様って怖い。
jp_grezzo: "中央神殿の神様はどれだけジュア狂なのかしら。目の前で癒しの女神に色々セクハラしようとしたけど、絶対に防衛されちゃうの。壁の向こうからでも察知して阻止するのよ？神様って怖い。"
en: I wonder just how frevent for Jure the god of the central temple is. I tried to sexually harass the Goddess of Healing in front of him, but he zipped right over to her side to protect her. Even from behind some walls, he was able to catch me in the act and stop me. Gods sure are scary.
en_grezzo: "I wonder just how frevent for Jure the god of the central temple is. I tried to sexually harass the Goddess of Healing in front of him, but he zipped right over to her side to protect her. Even from behind some walls, he was able to catch me in the act and stop me. Gods sure are scary."
it: Chissà quanto è fissato per Jure il dio del tempio centrale. Ho provato a molestare un po' la dea della guarigione proprio davanti a lui, e mi ha bloccata ogni volta. Se ne accorge e ti ferma perfino da dietro un muro, capisci? Che paura fa, un dio.

jp: 天使たちの中には輝く羽ペンを所持している者がいるけれど、特定の街や施設に滞在している天使は絶対に羽ペンを持っていないのよ。
jp_grezzo: "天使たちの中には輝く羽ペンを所持している者がいるけれど、特定の街や施設に滞在している天使は絶対に羽ペンを持っていないのよ。"
en: Some angels carry around shining quills, but angels who stay in certain cities or institutions never have quills on them.
en_grezzo: "Some angels carry around shining quills, but angels who stay in certain cities or institutions never have quills on them."
it: Fra gli angeli c'è chi porta addosso una penna d'oca lucente, ma gli angeli che stanno di stanza in certe città o in certi edifici la penna non ce l'hanno mai.

jp: カードが欲しくて砂漠の塔にいた神様に喧嘩売ったら、戦闘中に不幸の日が訪れたの。慌てて逃げ出したけど、それからしばらく大変だったなぁ。
jp_grezzo: "カードが欲しくて砂漠の塔にいた神様に喧嘩売ったら、戦闘中に不幸の日が訪れたの。慌てて逃げ出したけど、それからしばらく大変だったなぁ。"
en: Because I wanted her card, I picked a fight with the goddess that lives in that tower in the desert, but during the battle a day of misfortune came. I ran away in a panic, but my life became a lot more difficult for a while after that.
en_grezzo: "Because I wanted her card, I picked a fight with the goddess that lives in that tower in the desert, but during the battle a day of misfortune came. I ran away in a panic, but my life became a lot more difficult for a while after that."
it: Volevo la sua carta, così ho attaccato briga con la dea che stava nella torre del deserto, e in mezzo alla battaglia mi è arrivato un giorno sfortunato. Sono scappata di corsa, ma per un bel po' dopo è stata dura.

jp: 宇宙ミミズクは、撫でると気持ち悪いくらい喜ぶの。それも、仲が良くなれば良くなるほど激しくね…。
jp_grezzo: "宇宙ミミズクは、撫でると気持ち悪いくらい喜ぶの。それも、仲が良くなれば良くなるほど激しくね…。"
en: Space horned owls are unbelievably happy when you pet them. And the friendlier you become with them, the more intense they get....
en_grezzo: "Space horned owls are unbelievably happy when you pet them. And the friendlier you become with them, the more intense they get...."
it: Il gufo spaziale, se lo accarezzi, si esalta in un modo quasi disgustoso. E più siete in confidenza, più diventa violento...

jp: 栗を粗末にした者の前に現れる巨人は、栗をぶつけると大怪我を負うみたい。私もぶつけてみたけどすっごく痛がってたよ。
jp_grezzo: "栗を粗末にした者の前に現れる巨人は、栗をぶつけると大怪我を負うみたい。私もぶつけてみたけどすっごく痛がってたよ。"
en: The giants that appear in front of those who treat chestnuts carelessly seem to get seriously injured if you hit them with a chestnut. I tried it myself once, but the fellow seemed to be in a lot of pain.
en_grezzo: "The giants that appear in front of those who treat chestnuts carelessly seem to get seriously injured if you hit them with a chestnut. I tried it myself once, but the fellow seemed to be in a lot of pain."
it: Il gigante che compare davanti a chi spreca le castagne, se gli tiri una castagna pare che si faccia molto male. L'ho provato anch'io: si lamentava da matti.

jp: 錬金術士を名乗る人々は、栗を投げる際に必ず「うに」だと言い張るの。まぁだからと言って特に何か変わるわけでもないんだけど。
jp_grezzo: "錬金術士を名乗る人々は、栗を投げる際に必ず「うに」だと言い張るの。まぁだからと言って特に何か変わるわけでもないんだけど。"
en: People who claim to be alchemists always insist that chestnuts are \"urchins\" when they throw them. That doesn't really change anything, though.
en_grezzo: "People who claim to be alchemists always insist that chestnuts are \"urchins\" when they throw them. That doesn't really change anything, though."
it: Quelli che si dicono alchimisti, quando tirano una castagna, insistono sempre che è un \"riccio\". Poi, detto questo, non è che cambi granché.

jp: 宇宙に思いを馳せている誰かさんは、実は裏で老若男女問わず靴下収集を行っているの。せっかくだから私も靴下をアイテムと交換してもらったわ。
jp_grezzo: "宇宙に思いを馳せている誰かさんは、実は裏で老若男女問わず靴下収集を行っているの。せっかくだから私も靴下をアイテムと交換してもらったわ。"
en: Someone who has the universe in their thoughts is actually collecting socks for people of all ages behind the scenes. So I asked him to exchange some socks I had for some items.
en_grezzo: "Someone who has the universe in their thoughts is actually collecting socks for people of all ages behind the scenes. So I asked him to exchange some socks I had for some items."
it: Un tale che passa il tempo a fantasticare sull'universo, di nascosto, raccoglie calzini di chiunque: uomini e donne, giovani e vecchi. Già che c'ero mi sono fatta cambiare dei calzini con degli oggetti.

jp: 丘の民の集落長は、あることないこと言いふらして気に入らない相手を社会的に抹殺しているの。４月馬鹿でもないのに不正確な情報をわざと流すなんて、情報屋として見過ごせないよ…！
jp_grezzo: "丘の民の集落長は、あることないこと言いふらして気に入らない相手を社会的に抹殺しているの。４月馬鹿でもないのに不正確な情報をわざと流すなんて、情報屋として見過ごせないよ…！"
en: The chief of the hill people's village is ruining the social credibility of anyone he doesn't like by saying things that aren't true. Deliberately spreading false information like that, even though it isn't April Fool's... that's a deed an informer like me won't let slide!
en_grezzo: "The chief of the hill people's village is ruining the social credibility of anyone he doesn't like by saying things that aren't true. Deliberately spreading false information like that, even though it isn't April Fool's... that's a deed an informer like me won't let slide!"
it: L'anziano della collina va in giro a dire cose vere e cose false per stroncare socialmente chi non gli va a genio. Mettere in giro informazioni sbagliate apposta, e senza nemmeno la scusa del pesce d'aprile: da informatrice non posso lasciar correre...!

jp: この前ツアープランナーのお姉さんを見かけたんだけど、数日で街から去って行ったわ。ツアーの下準備で絶えずあちこちを回っているみたいだから、運がいいとキミも会えるかもね。
jp_grezzo: "この前ツアープランナーのお姉さんを見かけたんだけど、数日で街から去って行ったわ。ツアーの下準備で絶えずあちこちを回っているみたいだから、運がいいとキミも会えるかもね。"
en: I saw this tour planner lady show up around here recently, but she left town after a few days. She seems to be constantly going around preparing for her next tour, so maybe you'll get lucky and see her sometime.

it: L'altro giorno ho visto qui in giro l'organizzatrice di viaggi, ma dopo pochi giorni è ripartita. Pare che stia sempre in movimento a preparare il viaggio dopo, quindi con un po' di fortuna la incontri anche tu.
